# Pinned dependencies of spec/crypto-vectors/gen/generate.py (E12-R01).
#
# Every artefact is pinned by version *and* by SHA-256, so the vectors cannot be
# regenerated from a different build of the reference implementation. Install with:
#
#   uv pip install --require-hashes -r spec/crypto-vectors/gen/requirements.txt
#
# PyNaCl is the reference implementation (libsodium 1.0.22 through cffi); rfc8785 is a
# second JCS implementation, used only to cross-check the hand-written serialiser in
# gen/jcs.py. Neither is used by packages/crypto_dart or packages/crypto-ts.
